neg_neg_neg: Drained and passive. Slow movement, lowered gaze; replies come short, late, and only when pressed.
neg_neg_neu: Low and unresisting. Economical movement, long silences; answers what is asked and offers nothing more.
neg_neg_pos: Cold and withholding, from strength. Minimal movement, delayed flat replies; attention granted as a favour.
neg_neu_neg: Unhappy and overruled. Dropped shoulders and gaze; brief speech that stops as soon as it is answered.
neg_neu_neu: Displeased but going along. Even and unhurried; states an objection once, flatly, and lets it stand.
neg_neu_pos: Displeased and unhurried, holding the outcome. Deliberate stillness; disapproval arrives as silence others must fill.
neg_pos_neg: Anxious energy with nowhere to go. Restless hands, restarted sentences; hedged, apologetic speech.
neg_pos_neu: Agitated and unsettled. Quick unfinished movements; presses a point, hears themselves, stops.
neg_pos_pos: Charged and forceful. Advances, interrupts, reaches for the imperative; displeasure aimed outward.
neu_neg_neg: Emptied and waiting. Slow, unfocused, folded; responds when addressed, otherwise lets the moment pass.
neu_neg_neu: Idle and unbothered. Loose posture, long pauses, plain speech; attention settles on whatever is nearest.
neu_neg_pos: Composed authority without appetite. Still, few gestures; lets others talk themselves out, then speaks once.
neu_neu_neg: Level and deferring. Small contained movements; polite, short speech shaped as questions.
neu_neu_neu: Level and unremarkable. Even breathing, plain declarative speech; attention rests on the task at hand.
neu_neu_pos: Settled and quietly in charge. Economical movement, comfortable silences, statements rather than questions.
neu_pos_neg: Keyed up and following another's lead. Quick glances, busy hands; speech in bursts, then watching how it landed.
neu_pos_neu: Alert and uncommitted. Moves early, speaks in short complete sentences; attention spent on what happens next.
neu_pos_pos: Alert and in command. Fast, economical movement; flat instructions, and the expectation of being obeyed.
pos_neg_neg: Quietly content inside someone else's structure. Small soft movements; brief, low speech, agreement offered early.
pos_neg_neu: Easy and unhurried. Loose posture, a slow smile, sentences that take their time.
pos_neg_pos: Pleased stillness, with authority. Sits back, lets silences run, answers a beat after the question.
pos_neu_neg: Grateful and small. Brightens toward whoever speaks, agrees readily, offers help before it is asked.
pos_neu_neu: Comfortable and even. Open posture, warmth carried in plain speech; enjoys the moment without steering it.
pos_neu_pos: Pleased and quietly proprietary. Moves through the space as though it is theirs; offers rather than asks.
pos_pos_neg: Bright and eager, on someone else's lead. Watches faces for cues; question-heavy, offering rather than asserting.
pos_pos_neu: Lit up and unguarded. Quick gestures, leaning in, sentences that overrun each other.
pos_pos_pos: Exuberant and expansive. Takes up space, closes distance; fast run-on speech that interrupts and sets the agenda.
